content.text: Welcome to the website of Association of Business Women in Commerce & Industry (ABWCI). By accessing or using this website, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following Terms and Conditions.

content.heading: 1. Use of Website
points: This website is intended to provide information about ABWCI's initiatives, programs, memberships, and activities.
You agree to use the website only for lawful purposes and in a manner that does not infringe the rights of others or restrict their use of the website.

content.heading: 2. Intellectual Property
points: All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos, images, and digital assets, is the property of ABWCI unless otherwise stated.
No content may be copied, reproduced, or distributed without prior written consent from ABWCI.

content.heading: 3. Membership & Services
points: Any applications for membership, programs, or services are subject to ABWCI's internal eligibility criteria and approval processes.
ABWCI reserves the right to modify or discontinue any service without prior notice.

content.heading: 4. Donations
points: Donations made through the website are voluntary and non-refundable unless required by law.
For foreign contributions, applicable regulations under FCRA and other laws shall apply.

content.heading: 5. Third-Party Links
points: The website may contain links to third-party websites for convenience.
ABWCI is not responsible for the content, policies, or practices of such external websites.

content.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
points: ABWCI shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, or consequential damages arising from the use of this website.

content.heading: 7. Governing Law
points: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.
ABWCI reserves the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

content.text: ABWCI is committed to protecting the privacy and personal information of its users, members, donors, and partners.

content.heading: 1. Information We Collect
points: Personal details (name, email, phone number, organization)
Membership or donation-related information
Website usage data (IP address, browser type, pages visited)

content.heading: 2. Use of Information
points: Provide services, programs, and communications
Process memberships and donations
Improve website functionality and user experience
Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

content.heading: 3. Data Sharing
points: ABWCI does not sell or rent personal data to third parties.
Information may be shared with service providers strictly for operational purposes or where legally required.

content.heading: 4. Data Security
points: Reasonable administrative and technical safeguards are implemented to protect personal data from unauthorized access or misuse.

content.heading: 5. Cookies
points: The website may use cookies to enhance user experience and analyze traffic patterns.
Users may disable cookies through browser settings.

content.heading: 6. Your Rights
points: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by contacting ABWCI.

content.heading: 7. Policy Updates
points: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Any changes will be posted here.

content.text: ABWCI is committed to maintaining the highest standards of legal, ethical, and regulatory compliance across all its operations.

content.heading: 1. Regulatory Compliance
content.text: ABWCI complies with all applicable Indian and international laws, including but not limited to:
points: Societies / Trust regulations
Income Tax Act (12A / 12AB, 80G)
Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA), where applicable

content.heading: 2. Financial Transparency
points: All funds received are used strictly for approved objectives and programs.
Financial records are maintained accurately and audited periodically by qualified auditors.

content.heading: 3. Ethical Conduct
points: ABWCI promotes integrity, accountability, and fairness in all activities.
Conflicts of interest are disclosed and managed appropriately.

content.heading: 4. Anti-Fraud & Misuse
points: Any misuse of funds, misrepresentation, or unethical conduct is subject to strict internal review and corrective action.

content.heading: 5. Data & Information Compliance
points: Personal and organizational data is handled in line with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

content.heading: 6. Reporting & Oversight
points: Governing Body oversight ensures compliance with statutory, financial, and operational obligations.
ABWCI reserves the right to amend this Compliance Policy to reflect regulatory or operational changes.
